metrics.hypothesis: line-level family-composition entropy correlates with line length beyond a line-length-preserving global token shuffle
metrics.null_model: N1 global token shuffle (fixed line-length sequence)
metrics.interpretation: A significant result means longer lines are not simply proportionally more diverse than the global shuffle predicts.

metrics.hypothesis: raw glyph edit distance between two vocabulary types correlates with the minimum distance (in lines) between their occurrences, beyond a frequency-bin-matched permutation

metrics.limitations: Sampled, not exhaustive, over vocabulary pairs; occurrence lists are capped at 50 per token for cost.

null_registry.name: Global token shuffle
null_registry.preserves: corpus-wide token multiset (frequency), token length distribution
null_registry.destroys: essentially all sequence, line, locus, folio and regime structure
null_registry.remaining_confounders: none removed beyond the global marginal; too weak to be a sole control
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N1: usable only as a weak baseline, never the only control for a cross-scale claim

null_registry.name: Within-line shuffle
null_registry.preserves: each line's token multiset, line length, folio/section composition
null_registry.remaining_confounders: folio/regime-level composition differences remain (deliberately, since the hypothesis is about within-line position, not between-line composition)
null_registry.justification: isolates a within-line positional/adjacency effect from any line- or folio-level compositional confound, because every permutation is drawn from the same physical line

null_registry.name: Within-position-bucket shuffle
null_registry.preserves: the marginal distribution of token classes at each normalized line-position bucket (initial/interior/final), and the fixed sequence of line lengths
null_registry.destroys: which specific tokens/families occupy a given line's slots and the corpus's true line-composition structure
null_registry.remaining_confounders: position-class base rates are held fixed by construction, so this null targets composition/diversity effects net of the position-class marginal
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N3: used where the hypothesis concerns composition given position, not the position marginal itself

null_registry.name: Within-folio shuffle
null_registry.remaining_confounders: regime-level (Currier/section) composition, since folios are mostly regime-homogeneous
null_registry.justification: isolates a within-folio locus-type effect from cross-folio composition differences

null_registry.name: Within-regime shuffle
null_registry.preserves: Currier/section partition sizes and per-regime vocabulary composition
tests_hypotheses: CS5 (local context x larger regime), regime-stratum component of CS4
null_registry.remaining_confounders: does not by itself test whether the regime label matters, only whether structure exists within a regime once the regime is fixed
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N5: the direct within-partition analogue of N2 at the regime scale

null_registry.name: Frequency/length-matched random reassignment
null_registry.preserves: token length and (for the frequency-matched variant) log-frequency bin of both endpoints
null_registry.destroys: which specific same-length/frequency token pair is edit-adjacent
null_registry.remaining_confounders: residual within-bin frequency variation; bins are coarse (log2)
null_registry.justification: directly controls the frequency confound task77 §8 flags for CS7 ("высокочастотные токены по определению встречаются ближе друг к другу")

null_registry.name: C-GRAMMAR (structure-preserving / frequency-aware)
null_registry.preserves: token count, exact length distribution, alphabet, positional/endpoint/bigram glyph profiles within configured tolerance
null_registry.destroys: any lexical/paradigm structure beyond bounded token-formation constraints
null_registry.remaining_confounders: fairness of the C-GRAMMAR construction itself is a modeling choice, documented in FINGERPRINT_V2_CONTROLS.md
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N7: the only null that asks whether cross-scale/edit-family structure could arise purely from bounded token formation

null_registry.name: Family-label permutation
null_registry.preserves: family size distribution and each token's own frequency (tokens keep their identity; only which family number they carry is permuted)
null_registry.destroys: which specific tokens belong to which family
tests_hypotheses: incremental value of family identity over family-size structure (CS1/CS4 robustness check)
null_registry.remaining_confounders: graph topology within a family is not re-randomized, only membership labels
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N8: tests whether specific families carry information beyond size and frequency

cs7/edit-distance-x-structural-distance: NOT_SUPPORTED (raw glyph edit distance between two vocabulary types correlates with the minimum distance (in lines) between their occurrences, beyond a frequency-bin-matched permutation)
exploratory_findings: Connected-components-vs-label-propagation disagreement (see edit_graph_validation.transitive_merge.community_vs_components): any large ARI/NMI gap suggests the productive-rule graph's components merge sub-communities that a local, degree-aware method would keep separate. This is reported as a finding, not folded into any SUPPORTED verdict, and should be re-run as its own preregistered confirmatory test (e.g. a fixed, seed-independent community method) before task79.

Hub-removal sensitivity (edit_graph_validation.transitive_merge.hub_dependence): a large giant-component share drop under top-5%-degree removal is exploratory evidence that family connectivity concentrates on a few hub tokens; a dedicated hub-identity-stability test (which specific tokens are hubs across partitions) is deferred.

Locus-type SPECIAL bucket (comments/running/radial text, pooled for power in CS3) may hide heterogeneous sub-effects; a per-code confirmatory follow-up needs more data than most individual special-locus codes currently provide.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(glyph-length class, normalized line-position class)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: 2D-LITE uses order/categories only; it is not physical geometry.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token identity, initial/interior/final boundary class)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Detects boundary specialization, not plaintext or a reading direction.

metric_registry.definition: Share of vocabulary types in the largest edit component
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Share of isolated vocabulary types in edit graph
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Global edit-graph clustering coefficient
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Spearman correlation of edit degree and log frequency
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Between-folio share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: Between-locus share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: Between-section share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: NMI for Currier/section metadata association with token length/regime class
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Metadata classes are interpreted categorically only; association does not assign semantics.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token length class, documented locus type)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Locus type is documentary metadata and has unequal group sizes.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token length class, label versus running text), conditional on folio
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Label status derives only from documented locus codes; sparse labels reduce power.

metric_registry.definition: NMI for $I metadata association with token length/regime class
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Metadata classes are interpreted categorically only; association does not assign semantics.

metric_registry.definition: NMI for $X metadata association with token length/regime class
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Metadata classes are interpreted categorically only; association does not assign semantics.

metric_registry.definition: Concentration of directed edit-rule support
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Prefix-to-core normalized mutual information
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Suffix-to-core normalized mutual information
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: SD/mean of tokens per non-empty physical/logical IVTFF line
metric_registry.limitations: Line breaks in IVTFF are transcription metadata, not measured scan coordinates.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token identity, fixed five-class line position)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: High-cardinality token identity can inflate raw NMI; inference relies on within-line permutation.

metric_registry.definition: Absolute mean glyph-length difference between first and final tokens
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Length asymmetry is one boundary projection and has no semantic interpretation.

metric_registry.definition: Adjacent exact-token repetition rate within lines
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Only immediate recurrence is primary; longer recurrence distances remain diagnostic.

metric_registry.definition: Difference between mean across-folio and within-folio standardized line-profile distance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: IVTFF folio order is documentary; this statistic does not assume historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Mean adjacent-folio vocabulary-profile similarity
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Same-leaf recto/verso profile similarity advantage
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Mean absolute correlation of local line order with line length
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | line position) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: insufficient family-bearing occurrences with line-position metadata (need line metadata from ivtff_path)

metric_registry.definition: P(current family | previous-token family) != P(current family)
metric_registry.limitations: fewer than 20 family-bearing adjacent occurrence pairs

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | locus type) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: Locus-type codes beyond TEXT/LABEL are pooled into SPECIAL for statistical power; see report for the individual code counts.

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | Currier language) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: requires ivtff_path Currier metadata and >=4 folios; unavailable or below the 20-occurrence floor

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | section) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: requires ivtff_path section metadata and >=4 folios; unavailable or below the 20-occurrence floor

metric_registry.definition: same-family adjacency rate differs across regimes
metric_registry.limitations: requires >=2 sufficiently sampled Currier x section strata

metric_registry.definition: line-level family-composition entropy correlates with line length beyond a line-length-preserving global token shuffle
null_models: N1 global token shuffle (fixed line-length sequence)
metric_registry.limitations: Family composition is measured over {NONE plus each family}, so most of a typical line's entropy budget reflects the large NONE category.

metric_registry.definition: raw glyph edit distance between two vocabulary types correlates with the minimum distance (in lines) between their occurrences, beyond a frequency-bin-matched permutation
metric_registry.limitations: Sampled, not exhaustive, over vocabulary pairs; occurrence lists are capped at 50 per token for cost.

hierarchical_null_registry.name: C-GRAMMAR-derived controls
hierarchical_null_registry.remaining_confounders: original C-GRAMMAR has no learned page generator
hierarchical_null_registry.justification: only used where model preserves relevant marginals

null_registry.name: Global token shuffle
null_registry.preserves: corpus-wide token multiset (frequency), token length distribution
null_registry.destroys: essentially all sequence, line, locus, folio and regime structure
null_registry.remaining_confounders: none removed beyond the global marginal; too weak to be a sole control
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N1: usable only as a weak baseline, never the only control for a cross-scale claim

null_registry.name: Within-line shuffle
null_registry.preserves: each line's token multiset, line length, folio/section composition
null_registry.remaining_confounders: folio/regime-level composition differences remain (deliberately, since the hypothesis is about within-line position, not between-line composition)
null_registry.justification: isolates a within-line positional/adjacency effect from any line- or folio-level compositional confound, because every permutation is drawn from the same physical line

null_registry.name: Within-position-bucket shuffle
null_registry.preserves: the marginal distribution of token classes at each normalized line-position bucket (initial/interior/final), and the fixed sequence of line lengths
null_registry.destroys: which specific tokens/families occupy a given line's slots and the corpus's true line-composition structure
null_registry.remaining_confounders: position-class base rates are held fixed by construction, so this null targets composition/diversity effects net of the position-class marginal
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N3: used where the hypothesis concerns composition given position, not the position marginal itself

null_registry.name: Within-folio shuffle
null_registry.remaining_confounders: regime-level (Currier/section) composition, since folios are mostly regime-homogeneous
null_registry.justification: isolates a within-folio locus-type effect from cross-folio composition differences

null_registry.name: Within-regime shuffle
null_registry.preserves: Currier/section partition sizes and per-regime vocabulary composition
tests_hypotheses: CS5 (local context x larger regime), regime-stratum component of CS4
null_registry.remaining_confounders: does not by itself test whether the regime label matters, only whether structure exists within a regime once the regime is fixed
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N5: the direct within-partition analogue of N2 at the regime scale

null_registry.name: Frequency/length-matched random reassignment
null_registry.preserves: token length and (for the frequency-matched variant) log-frequency bin of both endpoints
null_registry.destroys: which specific same-length/frequency token pair is edit-adjacent
null_registry.remaining_confounders: residual within-bin frequency variation; bins are coarse (log2)
null_registry.justification: directly controls the frequency confound task77 §8 flags for CS7 ("высокочастотные токены по определению встречаются ближе друг к другу")

null_registry.name: C-GRAMMAR (structure-preserving / frequency-aware)
null_registry.preserves: token count, exact length distribution, alphabet, positional/endpoint/bigram glyph profiles within configured tolerance
null_registry.destroys: any lexical/paradigm structure beyond bounded token-formation constraints
null_registry.remaining_confounders: fairness of the C-GRAMMAR construction itself is a modeling choice, documented in FINGERPRINT_V2_CONTROLS.md
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N7: the only null that asks whether cross-scale/edit-family structure could arise purely from bounded token formation

null_registry.name: Family-label permutation
null_registry.preserves: family size distribution and each token's own frequency (tokens keep their identity; only which family number they carry is permuted)
null_registry.destroys: which specific tokens belong to which family
tests_hypotheses: incremental value of family identity over family-size structure (CS1/CS4 robustness check)
null_registry.remaining_confounders: graph topology within a family is not re-randomized, only membership labels
null_registry.justification: task77 §7 N8: tests whether specific families carry information beyond size and frequency

Hub-removal sensitivity (edit_graph_validation.transitive_merge.hub_dependence): a large giant-component share drop under top-5%-degree removal is exploratory evidence that family connectivity concentrates on a few hub tokens; a dedicated hub-identity-stability test (which specific tokens are hubs across partitions) is deferred.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(glyph-length class, normalized line-position class)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: 2D-LITE uses order/categories only; it is not physical geometry.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token identity, initial/interior/final boundary class)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Detects boundary specialization, not plaintext or a reading direction.

metric_registry.definition: Share of vocabulary types in the largest edit component
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Share of isolated vocabulary types in edit graph
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Global edit-graph clustering coefficient
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Spearman correlation of edit degree and log frequency
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Between-folio share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: Between-locus share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: Between-section share of line-length variance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Method-of-moments variance share is a robust descriptive decomposition, not a causal random-effects model.

metric_registry.definition: Concentration of directed edit-rule support
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Prefix-to-core normalized mutual information
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: Suffix-to-core normalized mutual information
metric_registry.uncertainty: see task75/task77 null distributions in raw_results.json
metric_registry.limitations: Inherited without changing the task75/task77 estimator or null.

metric_registry.definition: SD/mean of tokens per non-empty physical/logical IVTFF line
metric_registry.limitations: Line breaks in IVTFF are transcription metadata, not measured scan coordinates.

metric_registry.definition: NMI(token identity, fixed five-class line position)
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: High-cardinality token identity can inflate raw NMI; inference relies on within-line permutation.

metric_registry.definition: Absolute mean glyph-length difference between first and final tokens
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Length asymmetry is one boundary projection and has no semantic interpretation.

metric_registry.definition: Adjacent exact-token repetition rate within lines
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Only immediate recurrence is primary; longer recurrence distances remain diagnostic.

metric_registry.definition: Difference between mean across-folio and within-folio standardized line-profile distance
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: IVTFF folio order is documentary; this statistic does not assume historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Mean adjacent-folio vocabulary-profile similarity
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Same-leaf recto/verso profile similarity advantage
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: Mean absolute correlation of local line order with line length
metric_registry.parameter_sensitivity: ROBUST_WITH_LIMITATIONS: fixed preregistered categories; threshold-free statistic
metric_registry.limitations: Folio order is documentary and is not assumed to be original historical order.

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | line position) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: insufficient family-bearing occurrences with line-position metadata (need line metadata from ivtff_path)

metric_registry.definition: P(current family | previous-token family) != P(current family)
metric_registry.limitations: fewer than 20 family-bearing adjacent occurrence pairs

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | locus type) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: requires ivtff_path locus-type metadata; unavailable or below the 20-occurrence floor for this corpus

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | Currier language) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: requires ivtff_path Currier metadata and >=4 folios; unavailable or below the 20-occurrence floor

metric_registry.definition: P(edit family | section) != P(edit family)
metric_registry.limitations: requires ivtff_path section metadata and >=4 folios; unavailable or below the 20-occurrence floor

metric_registry.definition: same-family adjacency rate differs across regimes
metric_registry.limitations: requires >=2 sufficiently sampled Currier x section strata

metric_registry.definition: line-level family-composition entropy correlates with line length beyond a line-length-preserving global token shuffle
null_models: N1 global token shuffle (fixed line-length sequence)
metric_registry.limitations: Family composition is measured over {NONE plus each family}, so most of a typical line's entropy budget reflects the large NONE category.

metric_registry.definition: raw glyph edit distance between two vocabulary types correlates with the minimum distance (in lines) between their occurrences, beyond a frequency-bin-matched permutation
metric_registry.limitations: Sampled, not exhaustive, over vocabulary pairs; occurrence lists are capped at 50 per token for cost.

hierarchical_null_registry.name: C-GRAMMAR-derived controls
hierarchical_null_registry.remaining_confounders: original C-GRAMMAR has no learned page generator
hierarchical_null_registry.justification: only used where model preserves relevant marginals
